choice.basis: The chart title claims 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023', but the plotted data contradicts this. The data shows production fell from 2018 (2,800) to 2019 (2,400), then rose to 2020 (2,800), and then declined to 2021 (2,600), 2022 (2,600), and 2023 (2,600). The endpoint in 2023 (2,600) is lower than the 2018 start (2,800), and the recent 2021-2023 segment is nearly flat, not increasing. The title is refuted by the data. The endpoint change from 2018 to 2023 defines a net decline. The most authoritative evidence is the plotted data, which shows a decline from the start to the end of the period.
